dedupe_keys.name: replication data for digital exclusion and ict4ag adoption among smallholder farmers in puntland somalia structural gatekeepers awareness usage disparities and institutional pathways for inclusive digital agriculture

description: Citycot University researchers publish a replication package on digital exclusion and agricultural-technology adoption in Puntland, Somalia. The public Zenodo description identifies 110 surveyed smallholders, cooperative leaders and agricultural participants across Bosaso, Garowe and Carmo. Variables cover phone ownership, connectivity, electricity configurations, service awareness and use, costs, training barriers and extension support. The package includes a CSV, dictionary, analysis workflow and scripts for R, Python and Stata. Downloads are free under CC BY 4.0. These observations can inform agent-based adoption or dependency scenarios linking agriculture to telecom and electricity access. Surveying occurred in October–December, but the metadata do not state the year. No related catalogue record explicitly covers these observations. The sample is cross-sectional and does not establish population prevalence or causal effects. Provider claims about anonymisation and the reported statistical uncertainty were not independently checked; individual records and scripts were not opened.
